name: Suzanne Miles

bio.statement: Miles's pamphlet statement lists service as an assistant U.S. attorney in the District of Oregon and as a University of Oregon law professor.
bio.excerpt: US Department of Justice, Assistant US Attorney, District of Oregon; Law Professor, University of Oregon School of Law

bio.statement: Miles's pamphlet statement lists prior work as a regulatory specialist at the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency.
bio.excerpt: US Environmental Protection Agency, Regulatory Specialist;

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Miles says she would foster city partnerships with school communities.
positions.excerpt: SCHOOLS: Maintaining excellence in our schools by fostering city partnerships with our school communities

positions.statement: Miles's pamphlet statement supports local police and firefighters to keep the community safe.
positions.excerpt: SAFETY: Supporting our local police and firefighters to keep our community safe and welcoming

positions.statement: Miles's pamphlet statement says she would nurture natural resources to keep Lake Oswego green.
positions.excerpt: ENVIRONMENT: Nurturing our natural resources to keep Lake Oswego green and thriving

positions.statement: Miles's pamphlet statement says she would partner with businesses and community groups to support the local economy.
positions.excerpt: SMALL BUSINESS: Partnering with businesses and community groups as the heart of our healthy local economy
